title: Trust Under Siege: Label Spoofing Attacks against Machine Learning for Android Malware Detection
abstract: arXiv:2503.11841v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Machine Learning (ML) malware detectors rely heavily on crowd-sourced AntiVirus (AV) labels, with platforms like VirusTotal serving as trusted sources of malware annotations. But what if attackers could manipulate these labels to classify benign software as malicious? We introduce label spoofing attacks, a new threat that contaminates crowd-sourced datasets by embedding minimal and undetectable malicious patterns into benign samples. These patterns coerce AV engines into misclassifying legitimate files as harmful, enabling poisoning attacks against ML-based malware classifiers trained on those data. We demonstrate this scenario by developing AndroVenom, a methodology for polluting realistic data sources and launching subsequent poisoning attacks against ML malware detectors. Experiments show that not only are state-of-the-art feature extractors unable to filter such injections, but various ML models experience Denial-of-Service

translated_title: 信任受困：针对安卓恶意软件检测机器学习的标签欺骗攻击
translated_abstract: 机器学习（ML）恶意软件检测器严重依赖众包的反病毒（AV）标签，诸如VirusTotal之类的平台被视为恶意软件标注的可信来源。但如果攻击者能够操纵这些标签，将良性软件分类为恶意软件会怎样？我们提出了标签欺骗攻击，这是一种新威胁，通过在良性样本中嵌入极小且不可检测的恶意模式来污染众包数据集。这些模式迫使AV引擎将合法文件错误分类为有害文件，从而能够对基于这些数据训练的ML恶意软件分类器发起投毒攻击。我们通过开发AndroVenom来演示这一场景，这是一种污染真实数据源并对ML恶意软件检测器发起后续投毒攻击的方法论。实验表明，最先进的特征提取器不仅无法过滤此类注入，而且各种ML模型还会遭受拒绝服务攻击。
tldr: 本文提出标签欺骗攻击这一新威胁，并开发了AndroVenom方法，通过在良性样本中嵌入隐蔽的恶意模式污染众包反病毒标签数据，成功对基于机器学习的安卓恶意软件检测器发起投毒攻击，且现有最先进的特征提取器无法过滤此类注入。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces label spoofing attacks, a new threat that poisons crowd-sourced AV labels by embedding minimal and undetectable malicious patterns into benign samples through AndroVenom, successfully launching poisoning attacks against ML-based Android malware detectors that state-of-the-art feature extractors cannot filter.
